title: Hims & Hers launches new peptide treatments — while admitting there's more to learn about efficacy
summary_full: The telehealth company will now offer compounded forms of sermorelin, glutathione, NAD+,  vitamin B-12 and L-carnitine, none of which are approved by the FDA.
